prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink blob monster sheet for The Committee of Bad Habits, Social dynamics and distress as visual metaphors. Supplied original images are style references for soft full continuous charcoal-plum ink blob shapes and handcrafted props. Six individually distinct complete upright footless blobs in three columns and two rows, landscape 1536x1024, true transparent PNG. Equal substantial scale, generous clear transparent gutters and margins, all props inside the cell and attached or held. Thick rounded goo bodies, short ink hands, distinct facial shapes and expressions, ivory white sclera, red iris and black pupil, filled modeled eyelids, teeth behind lips. Large soft modeling marks, gentle satin plasticine with very sparse fine grain, broad fabric folds, clear glass and smooth plastic. Keep dominant ink bodies and period or symbolic accessories small. No copied wings, eyepatches or reference costumes. No floor, scene, text, labels, shadows, frame, branding, graphic distress or caricature of illness. Gentle surreal satire of habits, theory and bureaucracy. Color and craft direction: Rust, slate and amber on dark satin clay. Strong symbolic props. Row-major cast:
1. Female-read self-reinforcing echo chamber. two small tin speaking funnels facing one another. wide angled body, eyes following the echo, smug tight grin.
2. Male-read scapegoating habit. plain pointing-arrow token held upside down. squat broad blob, eyes averted, pinched defensive mouth.
3. Male-read status anxiety. one small stepped podium ornament and oversized blank badge. thin upright droplet, furrowed raised brows, worried closed lips.
4. Female-read rumination. short looped strip of smooth clay ribbon at belly. curved pear, downcast eyes tracking loop, tired flat mouth.
5. Male-read rising panic. palm-sized curled spring clutched in both hands. tall tilted blob, wide offset eyes, small round mouth.
6. Male-read avoidant habit. small clay folding screen held sideways at flank, full body visible. low curved blob, sideways watchful gaze, puckered lips.
Exactly six unique freestanding cutouts. Make the main motif of each slot legible at small sizes.
